# Ridhant Speciality Chemicals LLP

> Speciality chemicals trading and distribution company based in Kota, Rajasthan, India. Supplies metallic stearates, 12-HSA salts, PE & PP waxes, liquid stearate dispersions, antioxidants, fillers, food additives and polymer additives to manufacturers across India, with application and technical support.

Contact: info@ridhantchemicals.com, +91 99294 77295. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm IST. Technical data sheets, safety data sheets and samples on request.

## Product families

### Metallic Stearates
Zinc, calcium, magnesium and aluminium stearates, laurates and 12-HSA salts that work as lubricants, release agents, acid scavengers and stabilisers.
- Zinc Stearate: Lubricant, release agent and flatting agent. Improves flow and surface finish.
- Calcium Stearate: Acid scavenger and internal lubricant for PVC and polyolefins; water repellent for construction.
- Magnesium Stearate: Lubricant and anti-caking agent with a smooth, fine texture.
- Aluminium Stearate: Thickener, gelling and matting agent for paints, inks and greases.
- Sodium Stearate: Emulsifier and gelling agent; nucleating aid for polymers.
- Potassium Stearate: Emulsifier for latex and rubber compounding.
- Zinc Laurate: Activator and internal lubricant for rubber compounds.
- Zinc 12-Hydroxystearate: Zinc salt of 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA); lubricant and release agent for polymers and rubber.
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate: Lithium 12-HSA soap; the standard thickener for multipurpose and high-temperature lithium greases.
- Magnesium 12-Hydroxystearate: Magnesium 12-HSA salt; lubricant and thickening agent for greases and polymer processing.

### Liquid Dispersions
Water-based calcium and zinc stearate dispersions for clean, dust-free dosing in aqueous systems.
- Calcium Stearate Dispersion: Water-based dispersion for paper coatings, gypsum and waterproofing.
- Zinc Stearate Dispersion: Water-based anti-tack and release dispersion; matting for coatings.

### PE & PP Waxes
LDPE and HDPE polyethylene waxes, PP wax, oxidised PE wax, EBS wax and wax emulsions for processing, slip and surface finish.
- PE Wax (LDPE & HDPE): Processing aid and dispersant for masterbatch, PVC and hot-melt road-marking paint.
- PP Wax: High-melt wax for masterbatch dispersion and slip.
- Oxidised PE Wax: External lubricant for rigid PVC; adds gloss and release.
- PE Wax Emulsion: Adds scuff resistance, slip and water repellency to coatings, inks and paper.
- EBS Wax: Ethylene bis-stearamide for slip, anti-block and mould release.

### Antioxidants
Primary and secondary antioxidants that protect polymers and oils from heat and oxidation.
- Antioxidant 1010: Primary phenolic antioxidant for long-term thermal stability.
- Antioxidant 168: Phosphite secondary antioxidant for processing stability.
- Antioxidant 225 & blends: Synergistic 1010/168 blends for polyolefins.

### Fillers & Minerals
Talc and calcium oxide for reinforcement, nucleation and moisture scavenging.
- Talc: Reinforcing filler and nucleator; improves stiffness and processing.
- Calcium Oxide (CaO): Moisture scavenger for desiccant masterbatch and construction products.

### Food Additives
Preservatives and emulsifiers for bakery, dairy and processed foods.
- Calcium Propionate: Mould inhibitor for bread and bakery products.
- Sodium Propionate: Preservative for bakery, dairy and processed foods.
- GMS-SE / GMS-NSE: Glycerol monostearate, self- and non-self-emulsifying, for food and cosmetic emulsions.

### Polymer Additives
Antistats, lubricants, plasticisers, stabilisers and nucleators for plastics and PVC.
- Glycerol Monostearate (GMS / DMG 90 / 95): Distilled monoglyceride; antistatic and anti-shrink agent for EPE foam and films.
- PETS: Pentaerythritol tetrastearate; release agent and lubricant for engineering plastics.
- EGDS: Ethylene glycol distearate; pearlising agent and lubricant.
- ESBO: Epoxidised soybean oil; secondary plasticiser and co-stabiliser for PVC.
- ATO: Antimony trioxide; flame-retardant synergist.
- UV Stabilisers: Protect polymers and coatings against sunlight degradation.
- PVC Stabilisers: Heat stabiliser systems for pipes, profiles and cables.
- Nucleating Agents: Faster cycle times, higher clarity and stiffness in polypropylene.

## Industries served

- Plastic: Our broadest range: lubricants, antioxidants, nucleators, antistats and stabilisers for polyolefins, PVC, masterbatch and engineering plastics. We help processors improve melt flow, surface finish and long-term stability.
- Rubber: Activators, release agents and processing aids for tyres, technical rubber goods and latex. Zinc laurate, stearates and dispersions support faster mixing, cleaner release and consistent cure.
- Paints & Road Marking: PE waxes for hot-melt thermoplastic road-marking paint, plus matting, anti-settling and UV-protection additives for decorative and industrial paints.
- Ink & Coatings: Wax emulsions, stearate dispersions and matting agents for slip, scuff resistance and controlled gloss in printing inks and industrial coatings.
- Construction: Water repellents, PVC stabilisers and moisture scavengers for gypsum, waterproofing compounds, pipes and profiles.
- Paper: Calcium stearate dispersions, wax emulsions and talc for paper and board coatings, giving better runnability, less dusting and improved water resistance.
- EPE: Expanded polyethylene foam needs stable cells, low shrinkage and static control. We supply monoglycerides, talc and antioxidants that keep foam lines running consistently.
- Food: Food-grade preservatives and emulsifiers, including propionates and GMS, for longer shelf life and better texture in bakery and dairy.
- Personal Care: Stearates, GMS and EGDS for creams, powders and pearlised cleansers, with smooth texture and stable emulsions.
- Lubricants: Thickeners and antioxidants for greases and industrial lubricants, including lithium 12-hydroxystearate, aluminium stearate and calcium stearate.
- Petrochemicals: Stabilisation packages for polymer producers and refiners, built on phenolic and phosphite antioxidants.
